what_this_is: The verbatim stdout+stderr of scripts/deploy/deploy.sh --dry-run and of scripts/deploy/teardown.sh --dry-run, run against the LIVE AWS account and the LIVE CockroachDB Cloud cluster on 2026-08-11. Nothing here is transcribed by hand: each `stdout` array is the captured stream split on newlines, with NO_COLOR=1 set so no escape sequences appear. The account id is present because these are quoted transcripts, which decision D2 keeps as recorded evidence; it is removed from every executable default in the four deploy scripts, where `grep -c 022950218246` is now 0.

runs.claim: Read back from AWS after all of the above. No bucket named mainline*, no Lambda function in ap-southeast-1, no SSM parameter under /mainline/. The one CloudFront distribution belongs to a different project (origin checkout-platform-debd5edd-site) and is the correction this worker made to docs/deploy/RUNBOOK.md, which previously claimed list-distributions returns None and that this account has never had one.

not_proven_here: Stage 6's RUNTIME behaviour end to end. Reaching stage 6 through deploy.sh requires stage 1 to create the S3 state bucket and stage 2 to write the real mainline_api DSN to SSM as a SecureString. This worker has neither the operator secret nor authority to create billable resources, so stage 6 was verified statically (run F) and by the closed-gate line the preflight prints on every real invocation (runs A, B, C). The first execution of stage 6 will be the founder-approved run.

Stage 7's HTTPS proof. It cannot run before something is deployed. Its two assertions are GET / -> 200 with Content-Type text/html, and GET /v1/health -> 200 with a body whose cluster_version names CockroachDB, whose database equals mainline_demo, and whose schema_fingerprint is non-empty. Both were written against the measured shape of verticals/mainline/apps/demo-api/src/mainline_demo_api/health.py.

deploy.ps1 stages 1-9. The PowerShell twin's preflight and -DryRun were run on this machine and behave identically to the bash script; its later stages carry the same gate and the same guards but have not executed, for the same reason.

cross_domain_observations.observation: trappoint.schema_migration is EMPTY on the Cloud cluster: SELECT state, count(*) FROM trappoint.schema_migration GROUP BY state returns no rows, while trappoint.deploy_chain holds 1 row and trappoint.schema_attestation holds 1 (fingerprint ec9b1ce70a8df066...).
cross_domain_observations.consequence: GET /v1/health will report migrations_applied: 0 rather than 271, because health.py's HEALTH_STATEMENT counts trappoint.schema_migration WHERE state = 'applied'. It still answers 200, because `ok` keys on schema_fingerprint, which is present. Any check asserting migrations_applied == 271 against the live demo will fail.
